vendors.name: Wiz
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Agentless graph-based CNAPP that unifies CSPM, K8s security, and DSPM with contextual risk prioritization.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Default choice for Fortune 500 multi-cloud security teams requiring sub-hour visibility across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

vendors.name: Cyera
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Enterprise AI data security posture management that maps and protects sensitive unstructured data in LLM pipelines.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Strongest solution for CISOs facing AI governance mandates and complex hybrid-cloud data classification sprawl.

vendors.name: CrowdStrike
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Single lightweight sensor delivering cloud-native endpoint protection, Charlotte AI threat investigation, and OverWatch threat hunting.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Industry gold standard for endpoint telemetry and incident response, backed by unmatched threat intelligence graphs.

vendors.name: Palo Alto Networks
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Cortex XSIAM platform replacing traditional SIEMs with autonomous machine learning triage and native network firewall telemetry.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Top choice for large enterprises seeking platform consolidation across network, cloud, and autonomous SOC operations.

vendors.name: SentinelOne
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: On-device behavioral AI engine capable of autonomous threat containment and 1-click ransomware rollback without cloud latency.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Favorite among CISOs with distributed or disconnected field endpoints requiring instantaneous local machine remediation.

vendors.name: Zscaler
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Zero Trust Exchange delivering Agentic SOC workflows that correlate inline encrypted traffic with autonomous defense playbooks.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Essential inline security architecture for global enterprises replacing legacy VPN concentrators with Zero Trust SASE.

vendors.name: Chainguard
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Zero-CVE container base images (Chainguard Images) that systematically eradicate 97%+ of software supply-chain vulnerabilities.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Revolutionary for DevSecOps teams wanting to eliminate scanner vulnerability noise at the base container layer.

vendors.name: CyberArk
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Comprehensive identity security platform covering human and machine PAM, credential vaults, and real-time ITDR telemetry.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Mandatory privileged access control baseline for regulated financial services, healthcare, and critical infrastructure.

vendors.name: Silverfort
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Agentless identity protection platform that extends modern MFA to legacy Active Directory, service accounts, and OT systems.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Solves the chronic legacy Active Directory and command-line MFA blind spot without software agents or proxying.

vendors.name: Snyk
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Developer-first AppSec platform with native IDE and PR scanning, DeepCode AI fix suggestions, and IaC vulnerability detection.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Unrivaled developer adoption and GitHub/GitLab integration, though requires tuning to prevent backlog inflation.

vendors.name: Huntress
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Human-powered and AI-driven 24/7 managed detection and response (MDR) tailored for mid-market and MSP operations.
vendors.cisoVerdict: The gold standard for mid-market security leaders who need tier-3 SOC capabilities without multi-million dollar overhead.

vendors.name: Orca Security
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Pioneered SideScanning technology that reads cloud storage snapshots out-of-band with zero runtime overhead or host agents.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Excellent frictionless cloud audit tool that provides instant inventory and CVE mapping across disparate AWS/Azure accounts.

vendors.name: Axonius
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Cybersecurity Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) that connects to 900+ security tools to reveal unmanaged assets.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Invaluable for foundational asset discovery, compliance audits, and identifying devices missing EDR agents.

vendors.name: Claroty
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection for industrial OT, healthcare IoT, and smart building management protocols.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Top-tier operational technology defense for manufacturing, power grids, and hospital network environments.

vendors.name: Microsoft Defender XDR
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Native Windows and Azure telemetry correlation integrated directly into Microsoft E5 licensing and Sentinel SIEM.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Highest ROI option for Microsoft-centric enterprises with existing E5 licensing; requires skilled KQL analysts.

vendors.name: Checkmarx
vendors.primaryDifferentiator: Enterprise AppSec platform providing static code analysis, software composition, API security, and supply chain audit.
vendors.cisoVerdict: Robust scanning engine for legacy and modern multi-language enterprise codebases with strict compliance controls.

nominations.differentiator: Self-healing enterprise API firewall with real-time prompt isolation
